shared.title: Card heading: the data areas each company socio shares with everyone who uses it. "Socio" is a product noun (an AI agent).
shared.deleted: In place of the name of a socio that was deleted.
shared.manage: Link to the page where shared data is managed.
storage.title: Card heading: what the workspace stores, in bytes.
storage.chart-picker: Accessible name of the menu that picks which kind of storage the chart shows.
storage.kinds.datasets: Each storage.kinds.*: a kind of stored data. Datasets: tables of data.
storage.kinds.history: The kept history of datasets' rows (earlier versions).
storage.kind-note: Under a storage tile: {{items}} how many items, {{deleted}} the size of the deleted ones still kept (a formatted size).
storage.database: Stat tile label: the size of the server's database.
storage.chat-history: Under the Database tile: {{size}} (a formatted size) is the part taken by chat history.
storage.chart: Accessible name of the line chart: {{kind}} is one of storage.kinds.*.
storage.bucket: Chart axis name, lowercase: each point is an hour, day, week or month.
storage.unit: Under the chart: what its numbers are, one form for each point's span (hour, day, week, month).
quotas.title: Card heading: the limits on what each person may store in their data space.
quotas.description: "Settings → General" names the place in the app where the limits are set; keep it consistent with those names.
quotas.in-force: Column heading: the limit's value now.
quotas.fullest: Column heading: the highest use of the limit by anyone.
quotas.near: Column heading: how many people are at 80% of the limit or more.
quotas.at: Column heading (short): how many people have reached the limit.
quotas.labels.file: Each quotas.labels.*: a limit's name, as in Settings. The largest file a person may upload.
quotas.labels.dataset: The largest a single dataset may be.
quotas.labels.person: How much data one person may keep in total.
quotas.labels.datasets: How many datasets one person may have.
quotas.mb: A size limit or use, in megabytes.
quotas.datasets: A limit or use counted in datasets.
